title: Verbal Prefixes 6: при- (attach, slightly, bring along)
description: The prefix при- carries three closely related shades: arrival / attachment (привезти, привести, прийти), slightly / partly (приоткрыть, присесть), and bring-along / add-to (придумать, привезти подарок).
descriptionRussian: Приставка при- даёт три близких оттенка: приближение или прикрепление (привезти, привести, прийти), частичное действие (приоткрыть, присесть) и присоединение или прибавление (придумать, привезти подарок).
intro: You already know this prefix from motion verbs, where it meant arriving. Away from motion it keeps the idea of attaching something to a reference point, and it picks up a second use that is genuinely handy: doing an action only partly. Opening a door a crack and sitting down for a moment both use it.
rules: Shade 1 (arrival / attachment): при- on motion or bringing verbs → 'arrive at / attach to a reference point.' Прийти, приехать, привезти, привести, приклеить.
Shade 2 (slightly / partly): при- on action verbs → 'do X a bit, not all the way.' Приоткрыть, присесть, прилечь, приподнять.
Shade 3 (bring along / add to / think up): при- on production verbs → 'attach something new to what is there.' Придумать, прибавить, принести.
The result is perfective. Derived imperfectives exist (приоткрывать, придумывать, привозить); the perfectives are this lesson's focus.
Choose the shade by the root and context: motion / attachment for shade 1; partial-action verbs for shade 2; production / addition verbs for shade 3.
examples: Антон привёз подарки из Москвы. (Anton brought gifts from Moscow.) Shade 1: arrival + attachment, transport verb.
Маша приоткрыла окно, чтобы проветрить комнату. (Masha opened the window a crack to air the room.) Shade 2: partial.
Я придумал хороший план на выходные. (I (m) thought up a good plan for the weekend.) Shade 3: invent / add new.
Лена приклеила марку на конверт. (Lena glued the stamp on the envelope.) Shade 1: attachment.
Антон присел на стул на минуту и встал. (Anton sat down on the chair for a minute and got up.) Shade 2: partial, brief.
Маша принесла нам пирог из соседней пекарни. (Masha brought us a pie from the bakery next door.) Shade 3: bring along.

items.prompt: Маша _____ суп на плите перед обедом. (warm-up from Lesson 5)
items.promptEnglish: Masha heated the soup on the stove before lunch.
items.hint: Recap from Lesson 5: shade 2 of раз- (complete heating).
items.explanation: Recap from Lesson 5: 'разогревать на плите' uses the разо- variant of раз- → разогрела, the canonical 'reheat' form. Today's lesson moves to при- and its three shades.

items.prompt: Антон _____ подарки из Москвы для всей семьи.
items.promptEnglish: Anton brought gifts from Moscow for the whole family.
items.hint: 'From Moscow, for us here' = arrival at speaker's location. Shade 1: which prefix?
items.explanation: 'Из Москвы' source + 'для всей семьи' (the family is here, the gifts ended up here) signals shade 1 of при-: arrival at the speaker's location. Past masc pf привёз. Вёз is the impf process; повёз is onset of motion; увёз means 'took away from here.'

items.prompt: Маша _____ окно, чтобы немного проветрить комнату.
items.promptEnglish: Masha opened the window a crack to air the room a little.
items.hint: 'Немного проветрить' = a small opening, not all the way. Shade 2: which prefix?
items.explanation: 'Немного проветрить' (air a little) signals partial action: shade 2 of при-: приоткрыть (open slightly). Past fem приоткрыла. Открыла would be 'open fully'; закрыла is the opposite; открывала is the impf process.

items.promptEnglish: I (m) thought up a good plan for the weekend.
items.hint: Came up with a new plan. Shade 3: which prefix?
items.explanation: 'Came up with a good plan' signals shade 3 of при-: invent / think up something new → придумал. Past masc pf. Думал is the impf ongoing thinking; подумал means 'thought for a while / briefly'; передумал means 'changed one's mind' (which contradicts producing a new plan).

items.prompt: Лена _____ марку на конверт перед отправкой.
items.promptEnglish: Lena stuck the stamp on the envelope before sending it off.
items.hint: Stamp attached to envelope. Shade 1 (attachment): which prefix?
items.explanation: 'Stamp on the envelope before sending' signals shade 1 of при-: attachment. Past fem приклеила. Клеила is the impf process; поклеила means 'glued for a while' (briefer, less specific); переклеила would mean 'reglued / glued in a different place.'

items.prompt: Антон _____ соли в суп, потому что было пресно.
items.promptEnglish: Anton added some salt to the soup because it was bland.
items.hint: Added a small amount to what was already there. Shade 3 (add to): which prefix?
items.explanation: 'Was bland, so he added salt' signals shade 3 of при-: add to an existing total. Past masc прибавил. Сыпал is the impf process of pouring dry goods; посыпал means 'sprinkled' (a similar but more specific action); выпил is unrelated (drank up).

items.promptEnglish: Lena brought a pie from the bakery.
items.hint: Carrying TO the speaker's location, on foot.
items.explanation: При- marks bringing here: принесла пирог. Унесла is carrying away; отнесла delivering elsewhere; перенесла moving something across.

items.promptEnglish: Lena thought up a name for the dog.
items.hint: Creating something new by thinking: which prefix?
items.explanation: При- + думать gives 'invent, think up': придумала имя. Подумала means 'thought for a bit'; задумала 'conceived a plan'; надумала 'finally decided after mulling'.

items.promptEnglish: Anton opened the door a little to listen.
items.explanation: При- can mark a slight, partial action: приоткрыл ('opened a crack'). Открыл is a full opening; закрыл the opposite; переоткрыл is not standard.

blanks: Маша _____ нам пирог из соседней пекарни. (Masha brought us a pie from the bakery next door.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: 'Нам пирог из соседней пекарни' signals shade 3 of при-: bring something to the speaker's location for the speaker's benefit. Past fem pf принесла. Несла is the impf ongoing carrying; понесла is onset of motion (started carrying somewhere); унесла means 'took away' (opposite direction).

errorCorrection.sentence: Из пекарни Антон унёс нам свежий хлеб.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Anton brought us fresh bread from the bakery.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'Нам ... из пекарни' (to us, from the bakery) signals carrying the bread to the speaker's location, the при- shade: принёс. Унёс means 'carried away' (from here to elsewhere), the opposite direction. Отнёс would deliver it away from us.

errorCorrection.sentence: Маша долго думала и наконец передумала отличный подарок для брата.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Masha thought for a long time and finally came up with a great gift for her brother.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'Наконец [produced] отличный подарок' signals inventing something new, the при- shade 3: придумала (thought up). Передумала means 'changed one's mind' (and cannot take 'подарок' as a direct object this way). Подумала means 'thought for a bit'; раздумала means 'decided against doing something'. The при- prefix adds the 'come up with something new' shade to думать.

errorCorrection.sentence: Чтобы не разбудить ребёнка, Антон открыл дверь лишь на несколько сантиметров.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: So as not to wake the child, Anton opened the door just a few centimetres.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'Лишь на несколько сантиметров' (just a few centimetres) signals a partial opening, the при- shade 2 (slightly): приоткрыл (opened a crack). Открыл means 'opened (fully or neutrally)', which the just-a-few-centimetres framing narrows to the partial при- form. Закрыл is the opposite (closed); раскрыл means 'opened wide / flung open', also the opposite of slightly. The при- prefix adds the 'a little, not all the way' shade.

minimalPairs.context: Маша _____ окно, чтобы было свежо в комнате.
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Masha opened the window a crack so the room would be fresh. (partial)
minimalPairs.explanation: 'Чтобы было свежо' (so it would be fresh, just enough air) signals partial opening: shade 2 при- → приоткрыла. Открыла would frame full opening, which the 'свежо в комнате' framing does not require.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Anton brought an interesting story to the office. (brought along)
minimalPairs.explanation: 'An interesting story brought into the office' signals shade 3 of при-: bring along to the speaker's location → принёс. Перенёс would mean 'transferred / rescheduled' (different shade, 'across').

reviewVocab.definition: the prefix при- (turns the verb perfective and adds one of three shades: arrival / attachment, slightly / partly, or bring-along / add-to / think up)
reviewVocab.example: В предложениях 'Антон привёз подарки' и 'Маша приоткрыла окно' одна и та же приставка при- даёт два разных оттенка.

reviewVocab.definition: to bring near or to attach (shade 1 of при-; the action brings something to or fixes it at a reference point, often the speaker's location)
reviewVocab.example: В предложении 'Лена приклеила марку на конверт' приставка при- маркирует прикрепление одного предмета к другому.

reviewVocab.definition: slightly / partly (shade 2 of при-; the action is done a bit, not to its full extent; contrasts with the вы- 'completely' shade)
reviewVocab.example: В предложении 'Маша приоткрыла окно' приставка при- даёт смысл слегка / частично: окно открыто только наполовину.
